# Double Check

> Independent ingredient-verification site for skincare and makeup. Each case file checks a product's marketing claim against its actual ingredient list and available evidence, then gives a verdict: VERIFIED, MIXED, or FLAGGED. Verdicts are never changed for payment.

## Tools and pages
- [Ingredient Checker](https://www.doublecheck.blog/ingredient-checker.html): Paste any product's ingredient list and check each ingredient against a reference database.
- [Find Your Match](https://www.doublecheck.blog/find-your-match.html): Three-question quiz that matches skin type, main concern and budget to case files.
- [Makeup safe picks](https://www.doublecheck.blog/makeup.html): Quicker safety and transparency screen for makeup products.
- [About](https://www.doublecheck.blog/about.html): How cases are verified and what each verdict means.
- [Partner With Us](https://www.doublecheck.blog/partner-with-us.html): Contact for brands.
